items.title: Henry Johnson interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 30, 1995
items.q: Herbie Hancock has a different way of getting there

ctx.x: Or if it’s put in context.

Yeah because it’s only a way of getting there. What you’re looking at is the end result, and you might find a bunch of different ways to get there, and a bunch of different roads, but they all end up at the same spot. And I think that the ways that people get there is their own, that’s their identification. Say like McCoy has a different way if you’re just taking a regular two five, McCoy has a different way of getting there; Herbie Hancock has a different way of getting there, but that way of getting there…
Or build tension in such a way that you have the option to either fulfill or disguise.
